# Release version: 0.2.21

• Space folders now preview the servers inside them on the rail.
• Daccord links now open straight in the app on iOS.
• YouTube links show previews and play inline, only after you allow them.
• Joining a space or invite reuses an account you are already signed in to.
• Restored pasting into the composer on the web, tidied the space actions menu,
  and added an optional relay-only mode for voice on restrictive networks.
• Space icons and banners keep their crop, replaced images refresh right away,
  and member counts and last-week timestamps read correctly.
• Installs from a package manager no longer offer in-app updates.
